DRIVER STATION

Take the field.

WASD moves relative to the camera. Left / Right arrows turn; Q / E also work. Tank uses W/S to move and A/D or arrows to turn.

Space shoots into your hub inside your alliance zone. Outside it, Space passes to the marked home-zone landing target. I toggles intake. P pauses; R resets to robot selection. Scroll to zoom; drag in Free orbit to orbit.

Controller (standard mapping): left stick drives, right stick turns, A / Cross or right trigger shoots and passes, X / Square toggles intake, the D-pad selects a robot, A / Cross starts the match and returns to selection afterward, and Start / Options starts or pauses the match. Connect the controller and press a button while this page is focused.

The small roller marks the intake side; the block on top marks the shooter. Robots that fit start at a trench; taller robots start by a bump.

Before a match, choose a pre-loaded team. A three-second countdown runs before AUTO starts; pause or reset it at any time. To choose another, use Choose robot to reset the match.

Turret: swivels and shoots on the move. Big dumper: can shoot while moving. Aim assist snaps the chassis toward the target; moving accuracy controls spread. Lanes fire slightly irregular streams, sharing the average feed rate (up to 25 fuel/s). Drive speed is limited to 30% while shooting or passing with fuel. Shots outside the configured scoring range fall short. Longer shots use a higher arc. The yellow fill rises with stored fuel.

AUTO is driver-controlled in this simulator, as requested. Timing follows the 2026 sequence: 20s AUTO, 3s scoring delay, 10s transition, four alternating 25s hub shifts, and 30s end game. AUTO's fuel winner is inactive first; ties are randomized. Both hubs are active in AUTO, transition and end game. A 3s scoring grace follows deactivation.

All hub entries return to center, including inactive ones. One robot starts with 8 fuel; the center has 400, depots 48, and outposts 48 stored. Total: 504.

Single player with one pre-loaded robot. No climbing, foul assessment or human-player feeding. Field motion and distribution are simplified; unspecified team settings are estimates.
